title: Uka ofrendajj Destinoruw mayjtʼayäna
intro: Jaqinakan nayrïr urunakapanx mä almax q’uma amtanakampiw mä regalo luqtäna. Ukampis envidiasiñajj katoqatäñ chʼamakanwa uñstäna. Aka jaqin sarnaqäwip jikxatapxam khititix Diosar yupaychañapa ukat llaki tukuyäwipax Diosan qhanañchäwipan jan jiwañapatak uñt’ayatawa.
clues: Nayasti Tatitujaruw mä waxt'a luqtayäta, uka waxt'ax wali khuyapayasiñampiw katuqatäna.
Jilajan ofrendapajj janiw katoqatäkänti, envidiasiñas chuymap chʼamaktʼayäna.
Nayasti akham sasaw sista: ‘Jumatix nayar jiwayañatak amparam luqxatätaxa, janiw nayax jumar jiwayañatakix amparaj luqxatkäti; chiqpachansa nayax Allah, akapachan Tatituparuw axsararakta’ sasa.
Nayax aka Uraqin nayrïr jaqi jiwayañan jan walt’ayataw uñjasta.
Wilajajj wal jachäna, ukat nayajj jan juchani nayrïr mártir jaqëtwa.

arabic: ۞ وَٱتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأَ ٱبْنَىْ ءَادَمَ بِٱلْحَقِّ إِذْ قَرَّبَا قُرْبَانًۭا فَتُقُبِّلَ مِنْ أَحَدِهِمَا وَلَمْ يُتَقَبَّلْ مِنَ ٱلْـَٔاخَرِ قَالَ لَأَقْتُلَنَّكَ ۖ قَالَ إِنَّمَا يَتَقَبَّلُ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
verse: And recite to them the story of Adam's two sons, in truth, when they both made an offering [to Allāh], and it was accepted from one of them but was not accepted from the other. Said [the latter], "I will surely kill you." Said [the former], "Indeed, Allāh only accepts from the righteous [who fear Him]. (5:27)
